exposure: tendinous transection and suture method for deep inferior epigastric perforator (DIEP) flap elevation
cohort: 28 patients who underwent unilateral breast reconstruction using a DIEP flap with the tendinous transection method for multiple perforators between May 2018 and April 2020.
finding: The tendinous transection method in the DIEP flap procedure did not significantly affect postoperative rectus abdominis muscle volume, suggesting complete donor muscle recovery.
